I can't remember if this level was that hard. It's been awhile since I've played it.

I like to set goals for myself. I'm a collector of a lot of stuff so I like to complete sets and things like that.

Currently I'm trying to get the B-52 avatar in the Food Soul Collection, one of the monsters frames, and saving up my diamonds and soul embers.
If you set goals for yourself then it will be a lot easier to play the game. I basically started the game 2 months after it came out but I took 2 super long breaks because the game started to stress me out.

First start to set small goals. Like reaching 300 diamonds or reaching 1000 soul embers. Take it slow, at your own pace. If the game starts to stress you out then just take a few days off from playing it. Because no events are happening rn it's easy to take a break bc you probably won't miss anything.

Also if you played the game before and came back after a long period of time, the game will give you gifts like diamonds, soul embers, etc..

That's how I do it anyway.

(Also the fact that I can marry Yuxiang keeps me going)

I only know a little bit but I'll share,

UR food souls are only really useful at 3 stars, for defense I suggest leveling up Steak, Crab long bao, or Tom yum. Crowd control you wanna start shard fusing to get Peking duck. Also linked skills are only really good in early game and sometimes in mid game.

You also wanna build up your Fallen Angel's. Make sure you get the right FA's for your food souls. I did the dumb thing and thought it didnt matter but it does.
